Safety Tester for High-Voltage, Insulation, and Ground Bond Testing
Kikusui TOS9300: Electrical Safety Testing in Development, Quality Assurance, and Production
The Kikusui TOS9300 Series tests electrical devices and assemblies for dielectric withstand and insulation resistance. Depending on the model, additional functions include DC withstand voltage testing, ground bond resistance testing, leakage current measurement, or partial discharge testing.
AC and DC Withstand Voltage Testing up to 10 kV
The standard models of the 
Kikusui TOS9300 Series
perform AC withstand voltage testing at up to 5 kV and 100 mA. The TOS9311 reaches 10 kV AC at 50 mA and up to 10 kV DC.
Operation and Test Sequences
The 7-inch color display shows test parameters and sequence diagrams. Test values and sequences can be entered directly on the instrument and stored for repeated testing. The appropriate model depends on the required test voltage, protection class, and test procedures.
Integration into Computer-Controlled Test Stations
LAN, USB, and RS232C interfaces connect the instruments to PC-based test stations. Recurring test sequences can be run automatically. For multi-pole DUTs, the series can be expanded with the TOS9320 high-voltage scanner.
Alternative Products
For recurring AC/DC dielectric withstand, insulation resistance, and ground bond testing in production, consider the Associated Research HypotULTRA 78xx Series. If leakage current and functional run tests must be included in the same test process, the Associated Research OMNIA II 82xx Series is a suitable alternative.
Related Product Categories
Electrical Safety Testers | Hipot and High-Voltage Testers | Ground Bond Testers | Scanner and Matrix Systems
Which TOS9300 Configuration Fits Your Safety Test?
Test voltage, protection class, and required test methods determine the right configuration. We also help define test sequences, scanner expansion, and test station integration.

Specifications 
AC withstand voltage testing
 0.050 kV to 5.000 kV, up to 100 mA and 500 VA; output frequency 50 Hz or 60 Hz
DC withstand voltage testing
 0.050 kV to 7.200 kV, up to 20 mA and 100 W; automatic DUT discharge after testing (model-dependent)
Insulation resistance measurement
 0.001 MΩ to 100.0 GΩ; test voltage from −25 V to −1,000 V DC or +50 V to +7,200 V DC (test voltage range model-dependent)
Ground bond testing
 3.0 A to 42.0 A AC or DC; resistance measurement range 0.001 Ω to 0.600 Ω with contact check (TOS9302, TOS9303, TOS9303LC)
Leakage current measurement
 1 µA to 100 mA for DC and RMS readings; extended-mode measurement bandwidth from 0.1 Hz to 1 MHz (TOS9303LC)
Measuring networks
 for touch current, protective conductor current, and medical leakage current testing (TOS9303LC)
Partial discharge testing
 charge measurement range up to 10,000 pC, measurement of inception and extinction voltage, and pulse counting (TOS9301PD)
Test sequences
 combinable automatic test programs with up to 100 steps per program
Program memory
 up to 100 internal test programs; additional programs can be called via external control
Setup memory
 up to 51 test configurations stored in the instrument or on a USB storage device
Rise and fall times
 adjustable from 0.1 s to 200.0 s; test time from 0.1 s to 1,000.0 s
Current detection
 five selectable response speeds for evaluating breakdown and discharge events
Test voltage regulation
 PWM-based high-voltage source with voltage regulation of no more than 3% for AC and 1% for DC
Measurement functions
 true RMS and average current measurement, peak detection, and offset compensation for lead and stray effects
Grounding mode
 switchable between Low and Guard for standard testing or sensitive current and insulation measurements
Operation
 7-inch LCD for settings, measured values, test results, stored configurations, and automatic test programs
Standard digital interfaces
 LAN, USB host, USB device, and RS232C; LAN supports LXI Class C, VXI-11, HiSLIP, and SCPI-RAW
Control connections
 REMOTE, SIGNAL I/O, STATUS OUT, and connector for the TOS9320 high-voltage scanner
Analog monitor outputs
 voltage and current during withstand voltage testing; partial discharge charge and partial discharge current additionally available on the TOS9301PD
Multi-channel operation
 four channels per scanner, up to four scanners or 16 test channels per safety tester; integrated contact check (only with TOS9320)
Protection functions
 interlock, overload, overtemperature, output, ground fault, and communication monitoring with test voltage shutdown
AC input
 100 V to 120 V AC or 200 V to 240 V AC; allowable range 90 V to 132 V or 170 V to 250 V
Operating conditions
 indoor use up to 2,000 m altitude, operating temperature 0 °C to 40 °C
